title: Generator multiset cardinality
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $\ell>0$. For any irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$, the multiset of generator outputs, counting multiplicity over all pairs of length-$\ell$ binary seeds, has cardinality $(2^\ell)^2$.
hypotheses_covered: The implementation has an irreducible monic binary modulus of degree $\ell$
